decisions.reason: As a 2023 flagship line closely tied to the firm's core glass-processing capabilities and still carried in 2024, it likely meets or is close enough to aspiration levels that management would keep it unless clearer underperformance appears.

Although newer and therefore more uncertain, this 2024 flagship service fits the firm's strategic push into higher-value semiconductor applications and, with R&D capability and some organizational slack, would more likely be retained for further market learning than dropped quickly.
